effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

changes.historical_text: Neither player has to pay Life Points during the Standby Phase for Archfiend monsters. Each time a player's Archfiend Monster Card(s) are destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, except as a result of battle, that player can select 1 Archfiend Monster Card from his/her Deck that has a lower Level than the destroyed card and add it to his/her hand.
changes.summary: Period procedure, not a text erratum: when the destruction trigger resolves and the owner has no lower-Level 'Archfiend' monster left in the Deck, the goat script reveals the Deck (Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK) in the else branch after Duel.ConfirmCards); the modern script never reveals. The printed text carries no reveal wording in any lineage version.

changes.summary: Separate per-card era allowance: the modern target requires `Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard(s.filter,tp,LOCATION_DECK,0,1,nil,ev)` while the goat target only checks `e:GetHandler():IsRelateToEffect(e)`, so in the period implementation the optional Trigger can be activated and resolved with no eligible lower-Level 'Archfiend' in the Deck. Nothing in the packet dates the end of that allowance for this card.

review.notes: Two upstream codes, not within +/-10 of each other, so flagged for escalation per the review rules - but the packet settles which to use. Code 151000033 'Pandemonium (Action Field)' comes from cards-unofficial.cdb, its cdb text appends the Action Duel clause 'You can use Action Cards, but you can only have 1 Action Card in your hand.', its packet field uses_goatconfirm is false, and its target keeps the modern deck-existence check alongside IsRelateToEffect. It is an Action Duel field variant, not a period reconstruction, so the baseline is the GOAT code 504700165 (text_matches_version index 1, exact). Recording the pair for a human to confirm the Action Field entry is simply out of scope. Architecture note, deliberately not recorded as a change: the goat script uses an older effect layout - a card-registered EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD+EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS EVENT_TO_GRAVE watcher in LOCATION_FZONE, an EFFECT_TYPE_SINGLE trigger guarded by IsRelateToEffect, and Duel.RaiseSingleEvent - where the modern script uses aux.GlobalCheck plus an EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD trigger ranged to LOCATION_FZONE and Duel.RaiseEvent. The Action Field variant shares the same older layout, and the packet supplies no period evidence that it encodes a ruling, so it is treated as script vintage rather than era behaviour. Text lineage v1 (DR1-EN256, 2005-03-19) -> v2 (GLD1-EN037, 2008-04-02) -> v3 (SGX3-ENE14, 2023-03-30) is cosmetic: quoted 'Archfiend', 'Each time a player's ... that player can' -> 'When an ... : Its owner can', Life Points -> LP, Graveyard -> GY; the earlier v0 (DCR-094, 2003-12-01) 'fewer Level Stars' predates the baseline and means the same thing. Intermediate-state reasoning as for the other GoatConfirm cards: the two ruling transitions are unordered, no upstream implementation covers the state between them, and none is attached because GOAT (2005-04-01) and Edison (2010-04-24) both precede 2011-02-02.
